party-sheet.assigned-only-tooltip: Hide any actor not assigned to a player.
party-sheet.invalid-template:
The template you are using is invalid.
Please check the template and try again.
party-sheet.no-players: No players are currently logged in.
party-sheet.no-systems: You do not have any json files for this system in your data/partysheets folder. Please add some to enable this feature.
party-sheet.processing-error: There was an error processing the template for {name} by {author}.

preview-mode.active-tooltip: You are currently previewing a template from the Template Editor. Close the Template Editor to return to normal view.

hide-sheet.hint: Edit which actors are displayed if not showing online actors.

refresh-rate.name: Refresh Rate
refresh-rate.hint: How often the group sheet is refreshed in seconds. A lower value may cause performance issues. Default (off) is 0.

enable-minimal-view.name: Hide Support Buttons
enable-minimal-view.hint: Hide the buttons for bug reports and feedback.

enable-only-online.name: Show only online actors
enable-only-online.hint: Only show actors assigned to logged in players. Turning this off will show all non-NPC actors but allow you to 'hide' the ones you don't care about.

enable-dark-mode.name: Enable Dark Mode
enable-dark-mode.hint: Enable dark mode for the party sheet.

show-debug-info.name: Show Debug Information
show-debug-info.hint: Enable this to show debug information in the console for all parsed actors when the party sheet is opened. Hopefully this will allow you to track down specific properties that you are trying to parse.

show-template-status-form.name: Show Template Status Form
show-template-status-form.hint: This will show you which templates are out of date, which have newer systems installed, and which have no version information.

show-version-notifications.name: Show Template Update Notifications
show-version-notifications.hint: Display notification banners when installed templates have newer versions available in the module's example templates.

template-status.out-of-date: The following templates are out of date
template-status.newer-required-system: The following templates need newer systems installed
template-status.older-required-system: The following templates need older systems installed
template-status.no-version-information: The following templates have no version information
template-status.no-system-information: The following templates have no system information
template-status.valid-count: {count} loaded templates are valid and have no issues.

notifications.template-update-available: Template updates available! {count} installed template(s) have newer versions available. Check the Template Status dialog or use the Installer to update.
notifications.template-update-short: Party Sheet: {count} template update(s) available. Open the template installer to update.

template-editor.save-warnings: This data is temporary. Use the Save button to copy the template to your clipboard before closing.
template-editor.title: Template Editor
template-editor.copied: Template copied to clipboard! Paste into a text file and save as .json
template-editor.copy-dialog-hint: Copy the JSON below and save it manually as {filename}:

template-installer.loading-hint: Please wait while we fetch available templates for your system.
template-installer.error-hint: Check your internet connection or try again later.
template-installer.connection-error: Unable to connect to template repository ({status}). Please check your internet connection.
template-installer.none-found: No templates found for {system} in the repository.
template-installer.not-available: No templates available for {system} in the repository yet. Consider contributing one!
template-installer.incompatible: System version {current} is incompatible with this template (requires {min})
template-installer.incompatible-range: System version {current} is incompatible with this template (requires {min} - {max})
template-installer.no-community-templates: There are currently no community created templates available for your system.
template-installer.visit-readme: Visit {link} for more information on how to create your own.
